assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site and key-area polygons are repository provisional rough constraints, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive geometry, metrics, figures, PDFs, and HTML must be regenerated when trusted official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: The dual-track route, stations, scenario nodes, and building module are conceptual design objects without field verification.
assumptions.impact: Professional survey, accessibility review, operator assignment, privacy assessment, engineering checks, and public engagement are required before implementation.
